import re
from typing import List, Dict, Any, Union

# ------------------------------------------------------------
# Helper functions are assumed already present in the environment
# ------------------------------------------------------------

def entities(doc: Dict[str, Any], scope: str) -> List[Dict[str, str]]:
    """Return all distinct product entities described in the scope."""
    scope_node = node_by_title(doc, scope)
    prod_node = node_by_title(doc, f"{scope}: Products")
    prod_rows = table_rows(prod_node)

    ent_list = []
    for _, row in prod_rows:
        pid = row["product"]
        desc = f"{pid} ({row['group']}-{row['sub-group']})"
        ent_list.append({"id": pid, "description": desc})
    return ent_list


def recorded_end(doc: Dict[str, Any], scope: str) -> Union[float, None]:
    """Return the last day number recorded in the scope (as a float)."""
    ledger_node = node_by_title(doc, f"{scope}: Daily ledger")
    if ledger_node is None:
        return None
    ledger_rows = table_rows(ledger_node)
    max_day = -1
    for _, row in ledger_rows:
        try:
            d = int(row["day"])
            if d > max_day:
                max_day = d
        except Exception:
            continue
    return float(max_day) if max_day >= 0 else None


def _number_from_cell(cell: str) -> int:
    """Parse integer from a cell string, removing commas."""
    return int(cell.replace(",", "").strip())


def inputs(doc: Dict[str, Any], scope: str) -> List[Dict[str, Any]]:
    """Return all external inputs to the model within the given scope."""
    out = []
    # ------------------------
    # 1. Opening stock (state) – time 0
    # ------------------------
    prod_node = node_by_title(doc, f"{scope}: Products")
    prod_rows = table_rows(prod_node)
    for row_idx, row in prod_rows:
        pid = row["product"]
        ic = _number_from_cell(row["opening stock"])
        out.append({
            "id": f"input_open_{pid}",
            "time": 0.0,
            "kind": "state",
            "entities": [pid],
            "fields": {"opening_stock": ic},
            "src": [[prod_node["node_id"], row_idx, ["opening stock"]]]
        })
    # ------------------------
    # 2. Daily production and orders from ledger
    # ------------------------
    ledger_node = node_by_title(doc, f"{scope}: Daily ledger")
    ledger_rows = table_rows(ledger_node)
    for row_idx, row in ledger_rows:
        pid = row["product"]
        day = _number_from_cell(row["day"])
        prod_val = _number_from_cell(row["produced"])
        order_val = _number_from_cell(row["ordered"])
        # Production
        out.append({
            "id": f"input_prod_{predix := f'{scope}_{day}_{pid}'}",
            "time": float(day),
            "kind": "production",
            "entities": [pid],
            "fields": {"produced": prod_val},
            "src": [[ledger_node["node_id"], row_idx, ["produced"]]]
        })
        # Orders (requests)
        out.append({
            "id": f"input_order_{predix}",
            "time": float(day),
            "kind": "order_placement",
            "entities": [pid],
            "fields": {"ordered": order_val},
            "src": [[ledger_node["node_id"], row_idx, ["ordered"]]]
        })
    # ------------------------
    # 3. Future orders / scheduled production from Order book
    # ------------------------
    ob_node = node_by_title(doc, f"{scope}: Order book")
    if ob_node:
        ob_rows = table_rows(ob_node)
        for row_idx, row in ob_rows:
            # Try to fetch common columns
            if "ordered" in row:
                # For plants with 'ordered' column
                pid = row["product"]
                day = _number_from_cell(row["day placed"])
                ordered = _number_from_cell(row["ordered"])
                out.append({
                    "id": f"in_future_order_{scope}_{row_idx}",
                    "time": float(day),
                    "kind": "future_order",
                    "entities": [pid],
                    "fields": {"ordered": ordered},
                    "src": [[ob_node["node_id"], row_idx, ["ordered"]]]
                })
            elif "units still open" in row:
                pid = row["product"]
                day = _number_from_cell(row["day placed"])
                open_units = _number_from_cell(row["units still open"])
                out.append({
                    "id": f"in_open_order_{scope}_{row_idx}",
                    "time": float(day),
                    "kind": "open_order",
                    "entities": [pid],
                    "fields": {"open_units": open_units},
                    "src": [[ob_node["node_id"], row_idx, ["units still open"]]]
                })
            elif "planned production" in row:
                pid = row["product"]
                day = _number_from_cell(row["day placed"])
                planned = _number_from_cell(row["planned production"])
                out.append({
                    "id": f"scheduled_prod_{scope}_{row_idx}",
                    "time": float(day),
                    "kind": "scheduled_production",
                    "entities": [pid],
                    "fields": {"planned_production": planned},
                    "src": [[ob_node["node_id"], row_idx, ["planned production"]]]
                })
    # ------------------------
    # 4. Dispatch capacity – constant input (treated as param, not input)
    # ------------------------
    return out


def outcomes(doc: Dict[str, Any], scope: str) -> List[Dict[str, Any]]:
    """Return all outcomes recorded in the scope."""
    out = []

    # --------------- Daily ledger numeric values ---------------
    ledger_node = node_by_title(doc, f"{scope}: Daily ledger")
    if ledger_node:
        ledger_rows = table_rows(ledger_node)
        for row_idx, row in ledger_rows:
            pid = row["product"]
            day = _number_from_cell(row["day"])
            for col in ["shipped", "backordered", "stock"]:
                if col in row:
                    val = _number_from_cell(row[col])
                    out.append({
                        "time": float(day),
                        "kind": col,
                        "entities": [pid],
                        "value": val,
                        "src": [[ledger_node["node_id"], row_idx, [col]]]
                    })

    # --------------- Events --------------------
    events_node = node_by_title(doc, f"{scope}: Events")
    if events_node:
        for li, line in enumerate(events_node.get("lines", [])):
            # Map day
            m = re.search(r"Day (\d+)", line)
            day = float(m.group(1)) if m else None
            # Dispatch capacity reached
            if "dispatch capacity reached" in line.lower():
                out.append({
                    "time": day,
                    "kind": "capacity_reached",
                    "entities": [],
                    "value": None,
                    "src": [[events_node["node_id"], li]]
                })
            # Product runs out of stock
            mrun = re.search(r"(\w+?) runs out of stock", line)
            if mrun:
                prod = mrun.group(1)
                out.append({
                    "time": day,
                    "kind": "run_out_of_stock",
                    "entities": [prod],
                    "value": None,
                    "src": [[events_node["node_id"], li]]
                })
            # Order fully backordered
            if "order fully backordered" in line.lower():
                # Extract product if present
                prod = None
                mpr = re.search(r"(\w+?) order fully backordered", line.lower())
                if mpr:
                    prod = mpr.group(1)
                out.append({
                    "time": day,
                    "kind": "order_fully_backordered",
                    "entities": [prod] if prod else [],
                    "value": None,
                    "src": [[events_node["node_id"], li]]
                })
            # Backlog cleared
            if "backlog cleared" in line.lower():
                prod = None
                mpr = re.search(r"(\w+?) backlog cleared", line.lower())
                if mpr:
                    prod = mpr.group(1)
                out.append({
                    "time": day,
                    "kind": "backlog_cleared",
                    "entities": [prod] if prod else [],
                    "value": None,
                    "src": [[events_node["node_id"], li]]
                })

    return out


def params(doc: Dict[str, Any], scope: str) -> Dict[str, Any]:
    """Return constants that the document explicitly states."""
    params = {}
    # Dispatch capacity
    scope_node = node_by_title(doc, scope)
    txt = scope_node.get("text", "")
    mcap = re.search(r"Daily dispatch capacity:\s*([\d,]+)\s*kg", txt)
    if mcap:
        cap = int(mcap.group(1).replace(",", ""))
        params["dispatch_capacity_kg"] = cap

    # Product weights (kg per unit)
    prod_node = node_by_title(doc, f"{scope}: Products")
    prod_rows = table_rows(prod_node)
    weights = {}
    for _, row in prod_rows:
        pid = row["product"]
        w = _number_from_cell(row["kg per unit"])
        weights[pid] = w
    if weights:
        params["product_weights_kg"] = weights

    return params
